# Find an Expert

> University of Melbourne's expert directory and research collaboration platform connecting researchers, academics, and specialists across disciplines.

Find an Expert is the University of Melbourne's comprehensive directory for discovering faculty expertise and research collaborations. The platform features detailed profiles of researchers across multiple disciplines including economics, neuroscience, music, and business, enabling internal and external stakeholders to identify and connect with relevant experts.

## Key Topics

- Expert Directory
- Research Collaboration
- Faculty Profiles
- University of Melbourne
- Econometrics
- Neuroscience
- Music Pedagogy
- Financial Risk
- Stroke Research
- Associate Lecturer
- Faculty of Business and Economics
- Faculty of Fine Arts and Music
- Melbourne Conservatorium of Music
- Expertise Search
- Academic Profiles

## Core Directory

- [Find an Expert Homepage](https://findanexpert.unimelb.edu.au): Homepage for University of Melbourne expert directory and research collaboration platform

## Featured Experts

- [Dr Sam Ferraro](https://findanexpert.unimelb.edu.au/profile/1070256-sam-ferraro): Expert profile for Dr Sam Ferraro, econometrics and financial risk specialist in the Faculty of Business and Economics
- [Dr Kenji Fujimura](https://findanexpert.unimelb.edu.au/profile/1243-kenji-fujimura): Expert profile for Dr Kenji Fujimura, pianist, composer, and music pedagogue at Melbourne Conservatorium of Music
- [Dr Henry Zhao](https://findanexpert.unimelb.edu.au/profile/773708-henry-zhao): Expert profile for Dr Henry Zhao, neurosciences and stroke research specialist
